items.description: One console command a world document authors from existing verbs: commands rows. The registry answers it beside the engine's verbs — in help, from a binding row or wheel sector naming it, typed at any console — and runs it by submitting its lines, the arguments substituted, under the caller's own authority.

name.description: The command's namespaced name (debug.go), unique within the document and never a registered verb's.

help.description: The help text the listing shows before the command's usage, or null.

parameters.description: The parameters, in argument order; a required one never follows an optional one.

items.description: One typed parameter of a WorldConsoleCommand.

name.description: The parameter's name, which a line's {name} placeholder substitutes.

kind.description: What an argument for it must be.
kind.title: WorldConsoleCommandParameterKind

default.description: The argument a caller who omits it gets, written as it would be typed; null makes the argument required.

values.description: The admitted values of a Choice parameter, each one plain token; no other kind carries any.

items.title: WorldConsoleCommandParameter

lines.description: The console lines the command submits, in order. A {name} placeholder takes a parameter's argument and {{/}} stand for literal braces; the first token, the verb, is literal.

items.title: WorldConsoleCommand
